gaps.normative_requirement: The particular standard excludes battery-operated clocks.
gaps.finding_reason: The report claims application of the clock standard while also claiming that the appliance has a rechargeable battery; the construction and supply arrangements are insufficiently established to resolve the scope exclusion.
gaps.required_action: Establish the clock’s construction and supply arrangements and demonstrate the applicability of the claimed standard.

gaps.normative_requirement: The appliance is to be marked with its model or type reference.
gaps.finding_reason: Model 2508-01 is declared on the cover, but the report states that the test data are based on model 504D; their relationship is not established.
gaps.required_action: Provide traceable identification and evidence linking the tested sample to the declared model.

gaps.normative_requirement: Power input is measured at rated voltage and assessed against the applicable deviation.
gaps.finding_reason: The cover declares DC 3 V and 3 W, whereas the power-input table uses 5 V and a 1.0 W rating; the result cannot be attributed to the declared rating.
gaps.required_action: Resolve the rated voltage and power and provide a valid power-input assessment for the declared model.

gaps.normative_requirement: Motor-operated and combined appliances are tested at the most unfavourable voltage between 0.94 and 1.06 times rated voltage.
gaps.finding_reason: The heating record states 233.2 V and 253 V, inconsistent with the declared DC 3 V rating; the applicable test supply and attribution are not established.
gaps.required_action: Provide traceable heating results at the applicable test voltage for the declared construction.

gaps.normative_requirement: The appliance is supplied at rated voltage with continuous battery charging for 168 h.
gaps.finding_reason: A pass for the 168 h test is claimed, but the declared test period from 10 to 14 May 2026 spans only four days and cannot accommodate 168 h within that interval.
gaps.required_action: Provide authenticated test dates and records demonstrating completion of the 168 h test.

gaps.normative_requirement: Relevant tests are carried out on the appliance and its classification is verified by inspection and relevant tests.
gaps.finding_reason: Pages 108–113 contain sauna-heater and hand-held-appliance material and a class I classification, conflicting with the declared table clock and the class III classification on page 3.
gaps.required_action: Replace the affected pages with correctly attributed records and verify the integrity of the complete report.

gaps.normative_requirement: The applicable particular part supplements or modifies the corresponding general-part clauses.
gaps.finding_reason: The report claims IEC 60335-1:2020, while the supplied general part is US IEC 60335-1:2010; compliance with the supplied edition is not established by the claim alone, and the claimed 2020 edition was not supplied for review.
gaps.required_action: Provide an edition-specific assessment against the intended general part and supply IEC 60335-1:2020 if its claim is to be reviewed.

gaps.normative_requirement: Except for spring-driven clocks with electrically operated winding, clocks are operated with the rotor locked for normal operation.
gaps.finding_reason: The report gives heating results but does not establish the clock mechanism or whether the applicable locked-rotor condition was used.
gaps.required_action: Identify the clock mechanism and document the applicable normal-operation test condition.

gaps.normative_requirement: Leakage current is checked at operating temperature and following the humidity treatment using the applicable limits.
gaps.finding_reason: Both leakage-current tables are marked N/A and contain no measurements, although the report identifies a class III appliance; no adequate justification is recorded.
gaps.required_action: Provide the applicable leakage-current results or a construction-specific justification for any exclusion.

gaps.normative_requirement: The humidity treatment is conducted for 48 h at the specified humidity and temperature, followed by the Clause 16 tests.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records 93% RH and 48 h but gives no cabinet temperature or initial specimen temperature; the required subsequent leakage-current result is also absent.
gaps.required_action: Provide the humidity-conditioning temperatures and the applicable post-conditioning test results.

gaps.normative_requirement: Electronic circuits are evaluated against the specified fault conditions unless the stated low-power exemption conditions are satisfied.
gaps.finding_reason: A pass is claimed for electronic-circuit evaluation, but the fault-condition entries are N/A and the appended abnormal-operation table is uncompleted; the exemption is not demonstrated.
gaps.required_action: Document the circuit assessment, applicable faults, test results and any justified exemption.

gaps.normative_requirement: Appliances intended for use on a surface, other than fixed and hand-held appliances, must have adequate stability.
gaps.finding_reason: The product is declared as a table clock, but stability is marked N/A without establishing that an exception applies.
gaps.required_action: Establish the appliance classification and provide the stability test result if applicable.

gaps.normative_requirement: The particular standard specifies an impact energy of 0.20 J and limits application to dial glasses under the stated condition.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records 0.5 J on the plastic enclosure, not the specified 0.20 J, and does not establish the dial-glass assessment.
gaps.required_action: Document and assess the impact test using the particular-standard conditions.

gaps.normative_requirement: Appliances must not have hazardous ragged or sharp edges in normal use or user maintenance, subject to the stated functional exception.
gaps.finding_reason: The inspection is marked N/A without a construction-specific reason.
gaps.required_action: Inspect and record the assessment of accessible edges and fastener points.

gaps.normative_requirement: Components must comply with relevant IEC safety requirements as far as reasonably applicable.
gaps.finding_reason: The report claims a component-list pass and refers to an appended table, but no component list or supporting component evidence is supplied in the report.
gaps.required_action: Provide the component list and the applicable component compliance or test evidence.

gaps.normative_requirement: Class III appliances must have no provision for earthing.
gaps.finding_reason: The report classifies the clock as class III but marks the corresponding earthing-provision check N/A without an inspection result.
gaps.required_action: Inspect and record whether the appliance has any earthing provision.

gaps.normative_requirement: Clearances and creepage distances are assessed against the applicable electrical stresses, working voltage, material group and pollution degree.
gaps.finding_reason: Clause 29 is marked N/A solely because the stated working voltage is DC 5 V; the report supplies neither measurements nor a demonstrated applicable exemption.
gaps.required_action: Identify the relevant insulation paths and provide measurements or a substantiated exemption.

gaps.normative_requirement: Relevant external non-metallic parts whose deterioration could impair compliance are subjected to the specified heat-resistance assessment.
gaps.finding_reason: The report identifies a plastic enclosure but marks the ball-pressure assessment N/A and supplies no result or exclusion rationale.
gaps.required_action: Assess the enclosure’s applicability and provide the specified heat-resistance evidence where required.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable unattended-appliance connection materials and PCB base materials are assessed by the specified fire-resistance tests or permitted alternatives.
gaps.finding_reason: The report claims a pass for 30.2.3.1 but marks 30.2.3.2 and PCB base-material testing N/A without identifying applicable exemptions or material classifications.
gaps.required_action: Provide the applicable tests or documented exemption and material-classification evidence.

gaps.normative_requirement: Charging for the heating test lasts the period stated in the instructions or 24 h, whichever is longer.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records only "Period stated in the instructions"; neither that period nor the actual charging duration is given.
gaps.required_action: Record the specified and actual charging durations and verify the longer-period requirement.

final_summary.evaluation_conclusion: The submitted report does not provide a reliable basis for a compliance decision for model 2508-01. No product non-conformity is established solely from the documented inconsistencies; the report, test attribution, scope and missing evidence require resolution.
final_summary.recommended_action: Obtain an authenticated replacement report and supporting construction and test records, then reassess the identified model against the applicable editions before certification.
